d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Australia vs Mozambique in Group C of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Australia fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at Aspire Zone in Doha after Nhampule Junior and Khenzane put Mozambique ahead, with Luke Becvinovski pulling one back before half-time and Georgio Hassarati levelling late on. Australia top Group C on five points, while Mozambique finish third and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
